scientific_integrity: An analytical proof classifies all positive integer parameters; standalone exact and numerical checks are supporting evidence, not independent proof or external certification. Literature originality remains subject to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted adjacency Hamiltonian on finite double stars only; no Laplacian or weighted versions and no finite-time convergence estimate. Comparison with a recent Laplacian-quantum-walk paper is abstract-limited.
title: Exact kernel and sharp full-rank boundary for quantum average mixing on double-star trees
